headline: Gold rebounds ~2% to ~3,960 from 1-yr low 3,870 as oil drops; 3,978-4,000 is the test
summary: Fri: one-year low 3,870.25, close ~3,875.5 (-3.62% d, -3.74% wk, Kitco/Investing); worst October since 2008.
Drivers: Brent -4.2% to 108.66 on Iran-Qatar talks; tech-led liquidation eased. Dec Fed hike odds still ~75%.
ISM Mfg Oct 55.5 (prior 54.5), prices 75.2 (77.9). Saxo: gold must regain 4,000 to turn neutral.
Levels: R 3,978 (broken, FXEmpire) / 4,007.8 / 4,035; S 3,951.7 / 3,921.7 / 3,879. RSI 4h ~32 turning up.

plans.note: Fade into broken 3,978 (17 away); SL > 4,000/4,007.8; RR1.21

risk_note: Midterms Tue, results Wed BKK morning; NFP Fri. Rebound after RSI-17 rout can be sharp both ways; size small. Not financial advice.
